admission.capacityNote: 16 study places and one standby place. 159 applicants in 2024 and 136 in 2025.

selection.description: A mini portfolio of at most three pages of your own work, uploaded during the online test, plus five to ten everyday objects used in the test tasks.

Online admission test on 3 April 2027 (sign up by 18 March). The 30 to 35 highest scorers are invited to a test and interview in Copenhagen on 2 May 2027. Places go to the highest scorers after the final test.
An interview on the Copenhagen campus, as part of the second admission test.

requirements.label: An IB Diploma, or DP Course Results with at least 18 points, grade 3 in all six subjects and three of them at HL

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The rule is national, not this institution's. The Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 or more in all six subjects and three at HL, like a two-year hf without overbygning, which gives access to erhvervsakademi and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2. This is a professionsbachelor programme, which the Agency names directly. The institution's own page names the IB but says nothing about Course Results, so a Course candidate should confirm with admissions in writing. The award does not waive the subject requirements below.

requirements.label: English at B level (IB English B at SL or higher counts), or an accepted English test

alternatives.label: An accepted English test instead (for example IELTS Academic 6.5)

officialWording.text: Applicants, who do not have the required level, must take a language test. [...] IELTS Academic and online: 6.5 with a minimum score of 6,0 in each subcategory. Cambridge English C1 Advanced: 180

requirements.label: An online admission test with a mini portfolio, then a test and interview in Copenhagen if invited

officialWording.text: 1. An application on optagelse.dk 2. Online admission test with preparation. Mandatory. 3. Admission test in Copenhagen for invited applicants. Mandatory.

officialRequirementsText.text: A number of internationally recognized exams of the type "Baccalaureat" (like IB and EB) are considered equivalent to a Danish "stx" (3-year high school), and we have no further requirements regarding contents and level of subjects apart from English at level B. [...] IB English B (SL).

notes: The whole intake goes through quota 2. There is no grade-based quota 1.
Every student also pays a material fee each semester: DKK 2,678 for ceramics and DKK 3,346 for glass in autumn 2026. The 2027 fees will be published in March 2027.
The official opening of the study year is 1 September 2027, with introduction days on Bornholm in late August.
